title: My Awesome Day
shareTitle: My Awesome Day — Plan, Do, Review
description: Choose a cozy plan, complete a hands-on felt activity, name how it felt, and celebrate the learning power that helped.
learningGoals: Connect an intention to action and reflection
Practice visual matching and part-to-whole planning
Name feelings and recognize patience, problem solving, or creativity
interactionModel: Choose one of three plans, drag or tap four felt pieces to their matching places, then select one feeling and one learning power.
feedbackModel: Correct placements land with a warm sound and raster sparkle; near misses return gently; every reflection choice receives an affirming response.

modes.title: Plan, Do, Review
modes.skill: Follow one complete intention, action, feeling, and reflection sequence
